build_unet_conv_layer: build a UNet downsampling convolution block with configurable input/output channels and normalization
build_unet_upconv_layer: build a UNet upsampling transposed convolution block with optional outermost layer behavior
create_conv_block: create a two-layer convolution block with batch normalization and LeakyReLU activations
initialize_resnet18_features: initialize a ResNet18 feature extractor with custom input channels and optional fully connected layer
build_visual_voice_unet: build a VisualVoice UNet that combines audio spectrogram and visual features for speech separation
